title: 审计日志触发器（sqlite AFTER INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE 实跑）
expected_output:
=== 审计日志触发器 (sqlite 实跑) ===
account 表当前内容 = [(1, 'alice', 800)]
audit_log 共 4 条:
seq  ts                   actor   tbl       id   op      old            new
1    2026-10-09T09:05:00  app     account   1    INSERT  None           alice:1000
2    2026-10-09T09:07:00  app     account   2    INSERT  None           bob:500
3    2026-10-09T09:31:00  dba     account   1    UPDATE  alice:1000     alice:800
4    2026-10-09T21:42:00  ops     account   2    DELETE  bob:500        None
审计行数 = 业务写操作次数 = True
非工作时段(21:42)的删除可被追溯 = True
注意: 审计表必须与业务表分离存储, 且业务账号只被授予 INSERT 审计表的权限
code:
import sqlite3

DDL = [
    "CREATE TABLE clock(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), now TEXT NOT NULL)",
    "INSERT INTO clock(id, now) VALUES (1, '2026-10-09T09:00:00')",
    "CREATE TABLE session(user TEXT NOT NULL)",
    "INSERT INTO session(user) VALUES ('system')",
    "CREATE TABLE account(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, balance INT NOT NULL)",
    "CREATE TABLE audit_log(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, ts TEXT NOT NULL,"
    " actor TEXT NOT NULL, tbl TEXT NOT NULL, row_id INT, op TEXT NOT NULL,"
    " old_value TEXT, new_value TEXT)",
    "CREATE TRIGGER trg_account_ai AFTER INSERT ON account BEGIN"
    " INSERT INTO audit_log(ts, actor, tbl, row_id, op, old_value, new_value)"
    " VALUES ((SELECT now FROM clock), (SELECT user FROM session), 'account', NEW.id,"
    " 'INSERT', NULL, NEW.owner || ':' || NEW.balance); END",
    "CREATE TRIGGER trg_account_au AFTER UPDATE ON account BEGIN"
    " INSERT INTO audit_log(ts, actor, tbl, row_id, op, old_value, new_value)"
    " VALUES ((SELECT now FROM clock), (SELECT user FROM session), 'account', OLD.id,"
    " 'UPDATE', OLD.owner || ':' || OLD.balance, NEW.owner || ':' || NEW.balance); END",
    "CREATE TRIGGER trg_account_ad AFTER DELETE ON account BEGIN"
    " INSERT INTO audit_log(ts, actor, tbl, row_id, op, old_value, new_value)"
    " VALUES ((SELECT now FROM clock), (SELECT user FROM session), 'account', OLD.id,"
    " 'DELETE', OLD.owner || ':' || OLD.balance, NULL); END",
]

print("=== 审计日志触发器 (sqlite 实跑) ===")
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
for stmt in DDL:
    con.execute(stmt)
con.commit()


def act(ts, user, sql, params=()):
    con.execute("UPDATE clock SET now=?", (ts,))
    con.execute("DELETE FROM session")
    con.execute("INSERT INTO session(user) VALUES (?)", (user,))
    con.execute(sql, params)
    con.commit()


act("2026-10-09T09:05:00", "app", "INSERT INTO account(id,owner,balance) VALUES (?,?,?)", (1, "alice", 1000))
act("2026-10-09T09:07:00", "app", "INSERT INTO account(id,owner,balance) VALUES (?,?,?)", (2, "bob", 500))
act("2026-10-09T09:31:00", "dba", "UPDATE account SET balance=? WHERE id=?", (800, 1))
act("2026-10-09T21:42:00", "ops", "DELETE FROM account WHERE id=?", (2,))

print("account 表当前内容 =", con.execute(
    "SELECT id,owner,balance FROM account ORDER BY id").fetchall())
print("audit_log 共 %d 条:" % con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log").fetchone()[0])
print("%-4s %-20s %-7s %-9s %-4s %-7s %-14s %s" % (
    "seq", "ts", "actor", "tbl", "id", "op", "old", "new"))
for r in con.execute("SELECT seq,ts,actor,tbl,row_id,op,old_value,new_value"
                     " FROM audit_log ORDER BY seq"):
    print("%-4s %-20s %-7s %-9s %-4s %-7s %-14s %s" % (
        r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5], r[6], r[7]))

print("审计行数 = 业务写操作次数 =",
      con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log").fetchone()[0] == 4)
print("非工作时段(21:42)的删除可被追溯 =", any(
    r[0] == "2026-10-09T21:42:00" and r[1] == "ops"
    for r in con.execute("SELECT ts,actor FROM audit_log")))
print("注意: 审计表必须与业务表分离存储, 且业务账号只被授予 INSERT 审计表的权限")
